notes:
**Performance & Frame-Pacing Fix 5.0.2** — Eliminates scroll stutter, tab-switch jank, and Player lag.
- MiniPlayer & Headers: Replaced continuous relayout animations in MiniPlayerProgressBar with pure DrawPhase Canvas drawing and eliminated per-scroll-pixel relayout/recomposition in CollapsingScreenHeader
- Smooth Scrolling & Transitions: Replaced snap-halting horizontal carousel flings on Home with natural inertial scrolling, removed per-item spring coroutine allocations in bounceClick, downsized list artwork requests, and simplified tab and Player transitions without offscreen saveLayers
- Player Engine: Isolated live whisper lyrics from root PlayerScreen recomposition, removed expensive dynamic hardware shadows on SeekBar thumb and SwipeableArtwork, and cached Aurora RuntimeShader across opens
